## An equation

A short explanation followed by a rendered relationship.

$$V = IR$$

## A code example

```cpp
constexpr float referenceVoltage = 3.3f;
float readVoltage(unsigned sample) {
    return referenceVoltage * sample / 4095.0f;
}
```

## A technical table

| Signal | Unit | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Voltage | V | Electrical potential |
| Current | A | Flow of charge |

This temporary page checks the comfortable reading measure, navigation, headings, equation rendering, syntax highlighting, table layout, and table of contents. It is removed before deployment and is not presented as an article written by the owner.
